verdict.rationale: Filee's own watch folders feature converts files that land in a folder automatically and can move the originals aside, using configured presets. That is a real hands-off background automation, but the evidence is a single one-line mention limited to folder-triggered conversion. The scriptable CLI with --json output and exit codes is only a building block for user-built automation and earns no credit on its own. Missing for 10: details on how watch folders are configured and whether they run as a background service or at startup, other triggers or scheduling, multi-step automation rules beyond presets, and independent or hands-on corroboration that watch folders work reliably.
